CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-arch-shapes, at head ed1c9045e140b14e6a98fdb642942b6fa39aca71. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch ed1c9045e140b14e6a98fdb642942b6fa39aca71 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-arch-shapes, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-arch-shapes <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-arch-shapes; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
ROUND-2 NOTE (dispatch seat w67, 07:2xZ): the earlier cloud fixer for this group finished and its handoff is not ahead of the PR head 4b513acdd6529b3358e7cd7b29644ee65d415200; nobody owns the PR. FIXER (red gate) for #2819 (R10-ARCH-SHAPES, topic r10-arch-shapes, branch fix/r10-arch-shapes-pr). PR head is 4b513acdd6529b3358e7cd7b29644ee65d415200 (a ci-bot 'merge main' commit at 03:51Z); handoff/r10-arch-shapes is b5049f3fd (an ancestor), handoff-body 5526796e1. Continue from the PR head: fetch origin, merge origin/main if behind (merge, never rebase; install the merge drivers first: python3 tests/env_drift.py --install-merge-driver and python3 tools/merge/ledger_merge.py --install). Identity hpo-author via tools/pr/app_push.sh, never push.sh. First: git config user.name hpo-fixer && git config user.email 70032254+tvofi@users.noreply.github.com
WHY YOU: tick marks #2819 NOT REVIEWABLE at 4b513acd (required gate red) and no fixer was running. Read the real failures with bash tools/audit/seat/failure_logs.sh 2819 (it prints each failing check with the log's last error lines):
- gate 121398494487 (red because of the two below).
- pr-contract 121398295937: "check `prelude` is red and `## Red checks` does not name it. Name the failure and answer it: the cheaper detector and its standing cost, or the finding that none exists." The record line lists every red across the 40 commits between origin/main and this head: governance / delivery-status, prelude, tests / fast (3.14), tests / mutation, tests / mutation-autofix. Each must be named and answered in ## Red checks, one entry each, with whose it is (this branch's or main's; verify with the check-runs API against main's runs, three-dot, never two-dot), the cause, and the cheaper detector with its standing cost, or the finding that none exists (defect-root-cause.md cost test with numbers). governance / delivery-status is not a required context and is red on programme-wide OVERDUE rows.
- tests / mutation 121388964907 at 03:53Z: "MUTATION TABLE REFUSED -- 3887 unpinned site(s) against 3938 at the ratchet base f6784210, 13 of them added by this diff": ADDED UNPINNED sites at accuracy.py:124 CMP_BOUND; const.py:1335 GUARD_OFF; coordinator.py:417 CMP_BOUND; coordinator.py:4065 CMP_BOUND; dhw_schedule.py:151 CMP_BOUND and GUARD_OFF; inputs.py:391 GUARD_OFF; optimizer.py:1358 CMP_BOUND; quiet_windows.py:343 CMP_BOUND*2; sensor.py:1381 RETURN_DEL; wood_fuel.py:136 CMP_BOUND. This move PR relocates guarded code, so the sites are moved, not new: first check whether tests/mutation_pins' autofix (tests / mutation-pins, which tick shows RUNNING on this head) has already pinned them, and whether main's pin for each site's old location exists (a move PR silently reverts fixes in the moved block: diff each moved block against main's version, three-dot). Pin every site that still shows UNPINNED at your head with a killing check, or a survivor_triage entry with a reason; never loosen the ratchet.
TASK: (1) merge main and re-read the failures at your head; (2) cure the mutation sites; (3) RE-TAKE THE WHOLE BODY (three-round rule): headings from .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, only the arms that fire, every figure re-taken at the origin/main tip with date -u, ## Red checks answering all five reds; keep the carry routing so python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2819 prints 0 unrouted (8 carries, inline below); (4) run tools/pr/prepr.sh until clean and print the final output; (5) push handoff and its body through handoff_push.sh from the branch on your worktree. Do not move the head after the handoff; a delta review follows. No Claude footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer, no claude.ai link, no host path in anything pushed. No budget raise without the orchestrator's confirmation (state it in the handoff body).
ROSTER CARRIES FOR R10-ARCH-SHAPES (8, live roster at dispatch):
CARRY 1: A finite absurd reading (100 kW) still yields 6.0 after patch 03; a RANGE BOUND closes it, not only a finiteness check (CATCHUP-JUDGE.md at 33ffa7aa9). The finder's sign-blind perturbation is void; use the verifier's non-finite refusal arm.
CARRY 2: Patch 06 changes the pump arbiter's coercion answers (bool and string policy); state it in the pull request. Bool policy: True is not a number.
CARRY 3: Mutation-ledger re-key and a quiet-window stress re-take are owed.
CARRY 4: From R10-TARIFF (#2282, finding-propagation.md): dhw_schedule.py spells the weekday cyclic-range wrap a second time, in _parse_day_selector and _format_day_selector, beside grid_fee.py's cyclic-range owner (D7-s2-59), which parse_day_range and parse_month_range now use. Today 0 of 49 ordered day pairs disagree. The control is the weekday range twins harness under dev/audit/harnesses (r10_weekday_range_twins.py), which exists once #2282 lands: --perturb reads 49 and --identity reads 0. This group routes _parse_day_selector's range through the owner, has _format_day_selector share it where a sound shape exists, and removes the two dhw_schedule dispositions from tests/entities.py's P2 fact for the cyclic-range wrap. Re-measure with the census at the merge base.
CARRY 5: From R10-SENSOR-PAYLOAD (#2238 D8-s1-01, left open there): heating_now_while_off=1 at its head comes from active_now in coordinator._build_plan_views; the secondary 4 comes from the 0.05 kW threshold in _plan_slots. The DHW schedule sensor's fallback copies that threshold but never reaches this metric; move the fallback and _plan_slots' threshold together or D8-s1-02 reopens. Re-run the D8-s1-01 harness at your head.
CARRY 6: Carried from R10-FREQ-DEFROST (2026-10-20, assigned by the orchestrator rather than left routed to an issue): the `pump_offline` arm of D7-s2-01 is not closed. `_freq_fold_blocked` still admits `pump_offline`, and the finder's harness reads `freq_map` = INGEST on its `pump_offline` row at both the base and the FREQ-DEFROST head. The producing group scoped itself to defrost and carried it as `Carry: #2238` with no destination group. It lands here because this group owns `freq_control.py`, where the predicate lives, and `pump_offline` is defined in `pump_signals.py`, which no group owns. Also from the same handoff, worth attacking first when this group opens the file: the P2 registry entry pins decision-context attribute reads of `*.defrosting`, so a divergent predicate that copies the flag to a local first (`d = signals.defrosting; if d:`) is invisible to it — the class barrier is narrower than its name.
CARRY 7: Design step (owner ruling 2026-10-21): not needed; this group already has an approved design, pre-study or prototype, which serves as its design note.
CARRY 8: From R10-INPUT-STALENESS (#2683, head 07b83e9b2, Closes #2234; finding-propagation.md). Constraint on a new power-kW reader in custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/inputs.py: at 07b83e9b2, InputReader's default age limit is no longer a fixed table lookup. When the caller passes no limit, InputReader._begin chooses it per read with inputs.age_limit_for. That function holds a polling source to INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES and an on-change source to INPUT_ON_CHANGE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES, and inputs.source_polls decides which by whether last_reported has moved past last_updated. A new reader routes through InputReader so it inherits that choice. It must not read last_updated or last_reported, or compute an age, itself. Control: tests/entities.py's P2 stamp-reader registry (state_age) refuses an undispositioned stamp reader in inputs.py. At 07b83e9b2 it dispositions source_polls as the re-report fact. The #2683 r1 review (review/2683 486e987d5) ran the head's tests/features.py on base d05a44c63, where the P2 stamp-reader check fails, and at the head ALL 4345 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED. The comment fix to _RANGE_KEYS that this group also holds already landed at 07b83e9b2: git grep -n ATTR_MIN_TEMP custom_components prints nothing there. Drop that item and re-run the grep at your merge base. Re-measure the registry at your merge base with python3 tests/entities.py before and after the new reader.
